scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @upskillin/web" "npm run start:dev -w @upskillin/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @upskillin/web && npm run build -w @upskillin/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @upskillin/api && npm run test -w @upskillin/web
scripts.db:init: npm run prisma:generate -w @upskillin/api && npm run prisma:migrate -w @upskillin/api -- --name init && npm run prisma:seed -w @upskillin/api
